get.description: Medications you can order in the current mode. Prices are in cents. `requirements` names the optional prescription fields this pharmacy requires; `compoundingReasons` and `quantities` list the accepted values when the pharmacy limits them, counted in `quantityUnit` (a quantity of 1 for a vial is 1 mL). `pharmacyId` lists only that pharmacy's medications, and `name` only those with exactly that name: one medication's strengths, forms and pharmacies.

post.description: One request creates the order, signs it and sends it to the pharmacy. Platforms must send practiceId; practice callers can omit it to use their own practice. With an API key, name the prescriber and send signatureAttestation. Optional prescriber phone and address each default to the practice; no account is looked up by NPI. In the app, the signed-in member signs with the NPI in their settings, or names the prescriber with the same attestation. The patient is found by patient.externalId and updated from the order. Live orders require a default card or bank account on the payer (the platform for its practices); otherwise 409 payment_method_required is returned before creating an order.
post.summary: Create, sign and submit an order

get.description: List accessible orders in the current mode, newest first. `externalOrderId` matches exactly, including case. `updatedAfter` accepts an ISO 8601 timestamp with a timezone and returns strictly later updates. Keep filters fixed while paging. `sort` takes `patient` (name A to Z) or `created` (oldest first); a leading `-` reverses. Creation time or patient name and the order ID determine cursor order, even when updatedAt changes.

post.description: Platforms only. Name, phone and address are required. The practice starts in Test; `liveEnabled: true` also allows new Live orders, which needs a platform with Live access, a default card or bank account on the platform payer, and a Live caller: a Live key, or a session in Live mode. A missing method returns 409 payment_method_required. Turning Live off later preserves access to existing records.

liveEnabled.description: Effective Live access. A managed practice requires both its own Live setting and its platform's Live access.

patch.description: `liveEnabled` allows or refuses new Live orders. Existing records, cancellation, webhooks and billing keep working. Only its platform changes it; enabling requires platform Live access and a default card or bank account on the platform payer (409 payment_method_required otherwise), and either change needs a Live caller: a Live key (403 live_key_required otherwise) or a session in Live mode (403 live_mode_required otherwise). Live orders send `name`, `phone` and `address` to the pharmacy, so a practice with Live access changes them only with a Live key (403 live_mode_required otherwise).

post.description: Queue failed order event deliveries from the last 30 days for this endpoint. Only the current organization and mode apply. The worker retries each delivery up to 12 times with the same event ID and payload. Delivered, pending, and test events stay unchanged. Send a unique Idempotency-Key for each request. Reuse that key after an uncertain response to return the original count. A new request queues only deliveries that are still failed.
